questions.question: As of July 2023, who has become the second longest serving Chief Minister of an Indian states?

• Naveen Patnaik, the **Chief Minister of Odisha**, became the **second-longest serving Chief Minister** of an Indian state as of July 2023.
 
• He has been serving as the Chief Minister **since March 2000**, consistently winning elections and leading the Biju Janata Dal (BJD).
 
• Patnaik is known for his focus on** social welfare schemes and disaster management**, which have garnered him widespread popularity.
 
• His tenure has seen significant development in infrastructure, education, and healthcare in Odisha.

• He is known for implementing various **agriculture and rural development programs.**

• His tenure is far shorter compared to Naveen Patnaik's.

questions.question: What was India's literacy rate at the time of independence in 1947?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**12%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When the **British rule** ended in India in the year **1947**, the literacy rate was just around **12%**.
 
• The British rule in India refers to the period during which the Indian Subcontinent was under the colonial rule of the British Empire.
 
• It began in **1757**, following the** Battle of Plassey**, and continued until India gained independence on **August 15, 1947**.
 
• The British East India Company initially established a strong presence in India for trade, but over time, they gradually expanded their control over various **regions** and **Territories**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• According to the **2011 Census of India**, the overall rate of literacy is **73 percent**. But breaking up the national average reveals that while the rate of literacy for men is **80.9 **percent, for women it is** 65.46 percent**. This means that more than one-fourth of the country's population is still illiterate.
 
• Literacy forms an important input in the overall development of individuals enabling them to comprehend their social, political, and cultural environment better and respond to it appropriately.
 
• Higher levels of education and literacy lead to greater awareness and also contribute to the improvement of economic and social conditions.
 
• It acts as a catalyst for social upliftment enhancing the returns on investment made in almost every aspect of development effort, be it population control, health, hygiene, environmental degradation control, or employment of weaker sections of the society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The following are some of the important factors that could affect the low literacy rate of women in India-** 

 
 
• Poor school environment for girls 
 
• The lower enrolment 
 
• Dowry system 
 
• Early marriage
 
• Priority to the son’s education compared to the daughter’s education 
 
• Poverty

questions.question: The Sixth Economic Census of India was conducted in which of the following years?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2013**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sixth Economic Census was conducted between **January 2013 and April 2014 across the country**. This census follows a series of **economic censuses conducted since 1977.**
 
• The census was conducted by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) in collaboration with state governments and union territories.
 
• The census collected comprehensive data from** all non-agricultural **enterprises involved in various sectors such as manufacturing, trade, services, and others.
 
• The main objective was to collect information on the distribution of economic establishments, including data on their nature of activity, employment, and ownership patterns. 
 
• The **Sixth Economic Census** was **crucial for understanding changes in the economic structure**, including the growth of small businesses, employment trends, and the contribution of the informal sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **First Economic Census:** Conducted in 1977, marking the beginning of comprehensive data collection on India's non-agricultural sector.
 
• **Second Economic Census**: Held in 1980, focusing on the growth and expansion of enterprises.

questions.question: Which measure captures the difference between the government's total expenditure and total receipts, excluding borrowing?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The measure that captures the **difference between the government's total expenditure and total receipts**, excluding borrowing, is known as the Fiscal Deficit.
 
• Fiscal deficit occurs when a government's total expenditures exceed its total revenues (excluding borrowing).
 
• **Fiscal Deficit=Total Expenditure−Total Receipts (excluding borrowing).**
 
• **Revenue Deficit**: This is a subset of the fiscal deficit that focuses specifically on the gap between revenue expenditure and revenue receipts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Primary deficit refers to the difference between the government's total expenditure (excluding interest payments) and its total revenue (excluding borrowing).
 
• **Primary Deficit**=Fiscal Deficit−Interest Payments.
 
• Gross Fiscal Deficit is the difference between the total expenditure of the government and its total receipts (excluding borrowings)
 
• **Gross Fiscal Deficit**=Total Expenditure−Total Receipts (excluding borrowing).
 
• Revenue deficit refers to the excess of the government's revenue expenditure over its revenue receipts in a given fiscal period.
 
• **Revenue Deficit**=Revenue Expenditure−Revenue Receipts.

questions.question: One third part of a certain journey is covered at the speed of 24 km/hr, one fourth part at the speed of 36 km/hr and the rest part at the speed of 60 km/hr. What will be the average speed for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed for the first part = 24 km/hr.

Speed for the second part = 36 km/hr.

Speed for the third part = 60 km/hr.

**Formula Used:**

Average speed = Total distance travelled / Total Time

**Calculation:**

Let the total distance be d km.

Distance for the first part = d / 3 km

Distance for the second part = d / 4 km

Distance for the third part = d - (d/3 + d/4) = d - 7d/12 = 5d/12 km

Time taken for the first part = (d / 3) / 24 = d / 72 hr

Time taken for the second part = (d / 4) / 36 = d / 144 hr

Time taken for the third part = (5d / 12) / 60 = d / 144 hr

Total Time = d / 72 + d / 144 + d / 144

Total Time = d (1/72 + 1/144 + 1/144)

Total Time = d (2/144 + 1/72)

Total Time = d (4/144)

Average Speed = d / (d / 36)

Average Speed = 36 km/hr

**The correct answer is option 2: 36 km/hr.**
